user.title: HDAnywhere MHUB
user.description: Enter the address of your MHUB device.

zeroconf_confirm.description: An MHUB device "{name}" was found at {host}. Do you want to add it to Home Assistant?

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the MHUB device. Make sure the address is correct and the device is turned on.
error.timeout_connect: The connection took too long. Check the device address and confirm it is available on your network.

error.not_mhub: That address responded, but it isn't an MHUB device.

abort.already_in_progress: This MHUB is already being added.
abort.not_mhub: The device found on the network did not respond as an MHUB.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the discovered device.

init.title: Zone Control Setup
init.description:
Choose how each zone should be controlled:

{zone_list}

Use IR for zones connected through a uControl pack. Use CEC for HDMI-CEC control. Choose None if you do not want button controls created for that zone.

Save your changes, then reload the integration to apply them.

zone_commands.title: Command Selection - {zone_label}
zone_commands.description: Choose which {method} commands should appear as buttons for {zone_label}. Deselect anything you do not want to use. {command_count} commands available.
